rows.label: DESCENT
rows.clue: A movement downward

rows.label: SEMIFINAL
rows.clue: One of the two competitions in the next to the last round of an elimination tournament

rows.label: SELLING RACE
rows.clue: A horse race in which the winning horse must be put up for auction

rows.label: CLIFFHANGER
rows.clue: A contest whose outcome is uncertain up to the very end

rows.label: SETTLING
rows.clue: A gradual sinking to a lower level

rows.label: SHRINKAGE
rows.clue: Process or result of becoming less or smaller

rows.label: RELAY RACE
rows.clue: A race between teams

rows.label: ZING
rows.clue: A brief high-pitched buzzing or humming sound

rows.label: CLUMPING
rows.clue: The sound of a horse's hoofs hitting on a hard surface

rows.label: TING
rows.clue: A light clear metallic sound as of a small bell

rows.label: PULSE
rows.clue: (electronics) a sharp transient wave in the normal electrical state (or a series of such transients)

rows.label: SURFACE FIRE
rows.clue: A forest fire that burns only the surface litter and undergrowth

rows.label: DOGFIGHT
rows.clue: A fiercely disputed contest

rows.label: ECLIPSE
rows.clue: One celestial body obscures another

rows.label: REVOLUTION
rows.clue: A drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving

rows.label: LONG JUMP
rows.clue: A competition that involves jumping as far as possible from a running start

rows.label: PLUNK
rows.clue: A hollow twanging sound

rows.label: REPETITION
rows.clue: An event that repeats

rows.label: INTRUSION
rows.clue: Any entry into an area not previously occupied

rows.label: JUMP
rows.clue: A sudden and decisive increase

rows.label: BILLOW
rows.clue: A large sea wave

rows.label: STRIKING
rows.clue: The physical coming together of two or more things

rows.label: IMPACT
rows.clue: The striking of one body against another

rows.label: SUCCESS
rows.clue: An event that accomplishes its intended purpose

rows.label: GOLD RUSH
rows.clue: A sudden happening that brings good fortune (as a sudden opportunity to make money)

rows.label: STATIC
rows.clue: A crackling or hissing noise caused by electrical interference

rows.label: BLEND
rows.clue: An occurrence of thorough mixing

rows.label: PENTATHLON
rows.clue: An athletic contest consisting of five different events

rows.label: PLOP
rows.clue: The noise of a rounded object dropping into a liquid without a splash

rows.label: BELL RINGING
rows.clue: The sound of someone playing a set of bells

rows.label: FLUTTERING
rows.clue: The motion made by flapping up and down

rows.label: ROLL
rows.clue: Rotary motion of an object around its own axis

rows.label: DISCUS
rows.clue: An athletic competition in which a disk-shaped object is thrown as far as possible

rows.label: JUST DESERTS
rows.clue: An outcome in which virtue triumphs over vice (often ironically)

rows.label: FLICK
rows.clue: A light sharp contact (usually with something flexible)

rows.label: GENESIS
rows.clue: A coming into being

rows.label: SOCIAL EVENT
rows.clue: An event characteristic of persons forming groups

rows.label: RAVE
rows.clue: A dance party that lasts all night and electronically synthesized music is played

rows.label: PROM
rows.clue: A formal ball held for a school class toward the end of the academic year

rows.label: AVALANCHE
rows.clue: A slide of large masses of snow and ice and mud down a mountain

rows.label: GLIMMER
rows.clue: A flash of light (especially reflected light)

rows.label: PRELUDE
rows.clue: Something that serves as a preceding event or introduces what follows

rows.label: REBOUND
rows.clue: A movement back from an impact

rows.label: INCEPTION
rows.clue: An event that is a beginning

rows.label: AMPLITUDE
rows.clue: (physics) the maximum displacement of a periodic wave

rows.label: BLAST WAVE
rows.clue: A region of high pressure travelling through a gas at a high velocity

rows.label: CAR RACE
rows.clue: A race between (usually high-performance) automobiles

rows.label: DISLOCATION
rows.clue: An event that results in a displacement or discontinuity

rows.label: EASING
rows.clue: A change for the better

rows.label: FAINT
rows.clue: A spontaneous loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood to the brain

rows.label: COMPRESSION
rows.clue: An increase in the density of something

rows.label: HEAD TRIP
rows.clue: An exciting or stimulating experience

rows.label: CAM STROKE
rows.clue: The maximum movement available to a pivoted or reciprocating piece by a cam

rows.label: RAVAGE
rows.clue: (usually plural) a destructive action

rows.label: THROBBING
rows.clue: An instance of rapid strong pulsation (of the heart)

rows.label: WRECKING
rows.clue: The event of a structure being completely demolished and leveled
